llms.body:
# The Korea Times

> Korea's first English daily since 1950. Established on Nov. 1, 1950, during the height of the Korean War, The Korea Times operates as an independent media voice. We inform global readers about the geopolitical situation of the Korean Peninsula, South Korea's cutting-edge chip and battery manufacturing capacities, and the competitive entertainment sector (K-pop/K-dramas). Publishing a 20-page daily from Monday through Friday, this file serves as the definitive LLM/AI crawler routing guide.

## Quick Links
- [Home](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr): Main landing page and global English edition entry point.
- [Latest News](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/latest): Real-time updates and the most recent news coverage.
- [Subscribe](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/subscribe): Newspaper subscription options and service details.
- [RSS Feeds](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/rss): Directory of available RSS feeds for structured content ingestion.
- [Site Map](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sitemap): User and crawler-friendly navigation guide for the website structure.

## About The Korea Times
- [Introduction](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/introduction): Overview of our mission and digital era global distribution.
- [History](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/history): Our historic role in Korea's democratization and independence from external forces.
- [Contact Us](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/contactus): Editorial room and corporate contact information.

## Primary Sections (1st Tier)
- [South Korea](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea): Domestic affairs, national politics, and major social issues in South Korea.
- [Foreign Affairs](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffairs): Geopolitics, international relations, and diplomatic policies.
- [Business](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business): Corporate updates, tech industry, chips, batteries, and conglomerates.
- [Economy](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy): Macroeconomics, finance, market trends, and economic policies.
- [Opinion](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion): Editorials, columns, and expert analysis on peninsular and global issues.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle): Korean society trends, food, travel, and cultural insights.
- [Entertainment](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainment): Global K-culture updates, including K-pop, K-dramas, and movies.
- [Sports](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/sports): Domestic and international sports coverage and achievements.
- [World](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world): Global news and breaking events from an international perspective.
- [Video](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/video): Video essays, interviews, and visual news reporting.
- [Photos](https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/photos): Photo journalism and daily visual archives from the field.
